text: Mikael Strand | C | Shoots L | 6'0" 181 lbs | SHL. Dynamic skater who wins races with a quick first step. Vision and passing are excellent; sees lanes before they open. Shot is average at best. Defensive game needs work. Projects as a top-six forward.

Brody Kerr, a 6-foot-3, 210-pound left-shot defenceman from the WHL. Physical game is a weapon and gap control is strong. Skating is heavy-footed. Decision-making with the puck is a question mark. Projects as a third-pair defenceman.

Teemu Lehtonen | RW | Shoots R | 5'10" 172 lbs | Liiga. Release is elite and the one-timer is dangerous from the circle. Not a strong skater. Compete level is inconsistent. Projects as a middle-six forward.

Carter Walsh, a 6-foot-1, 195-pound right-shot center from the OHL. Hockey sense is outstanding and the reads in all three zones are very good. Motor never stops; work ethic is a real strength. Passing is solid. Projects as a second-line forward.

Jonas Halvorsen | D | Shoots L | 6'2" 199 lbs | NCAA. Smooth, effortless stride with good edges. Puck distribution is sharp. Own-zone coverage is sloppy and the physical play is weak. Projects as a second-pair defenceman.

Nolan Pelletier, a 5-foot-11, 178-pound left-shot left winger from the QMJHL. Shooting is a real strength. Skating is fine. Defensive play is a liability and effort comes and goes. Projects as a bottom-six forward.

Viktor Morozov | LW | Shoots L | 6'4" 220 lbs | KHL. Net-front presence is excellent and puck protection is very good. Speed is below average. Hockey IQ is solid. Shot is heavy. Projects as a middle-six forward.
Gabe Novak, a 6-foot, 185-pound right-shot defenseman from the USHL. Mobility is high-end. Decisions under pressure are not great. Battle level is good. Projects as a top-four defenceman.

Oskar Bergeron | C | Shoots R | 5'9" 168 lbs | Allsvenskan. Playmaking is exceptional. Skating is average. Size is a red flag in board play and the defensive game is poor. Projects as a depth forward.

Dylan Ivanov, a 6-foot-2, 201-pound left-shot blueliner from the OHL. Positioning is reliable and the stick detail is very good. Passing is limited. Skating is a tick above average. Projects as a third-pair defenceman.
Anton Virtanen | RW | Shoots R | 6'0" 183 lbs | Liiga. Elite anticipation; always a step ahead of the play. Shot is somewhat underwhelming. Compete is never an issue. Projects as a top-six forward.

Eli Fischer, a 5-foot-11, 190-pound left-shot center from the NCAA. Faceoffs aside, the two-way game is reliable: backchecking is excellent and the gaps are tight. Shooting is mediocre. Skating is fine. Projects as a bottom-six forward.
